# Is your sitemap ever actually read?

> A site published at a URL subpath — user.github.io/repo/, gitlab.io/project/, a CDN subdirectory — cannot govern its own robots.txt, so its sitemap is never auto-discovered and its pages are never enumerated. Paste your site URL to find out. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
